answer_2.quote: We use two no-reference image quality metrics PIQE and BRISQUE ... additionally we calculate SSIM between adjacent frames, denoted as SSIM-sim ... we also include CLIP-Score and X-CLIP-Score as metrics in this dimension.

answer_3.quote: We designed a prompting template ... let them output scores ranging from 1 (Bad) to 4 (Perfect) for each aspect. MLLMs like LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-1.6, Gemini-1.5-Flash, GPT-4o were evaluated.
methods: prompting with template to obtain per-aspect scores

answer_4.quote: We hired 20 expert raters, with each rater performing rating for 1K-2K videos. For each aspect, there are three available ratings ... The annotation process includes a checklist for error points for each dimension.
answer_4.guideline: Definition and checklist of error points in five evaluation dimensions (Visual Quality, Temporal Consistency, Dynamic Degree, Text-to-Video Alignment, Factual Consistency) were provided to raters.
